clue.text: Setters return, breaking dog's entrance

indicators.note: breaking means one piece smashes its way into the middle of the other

parts.note: a female dog is a bitch; the 's is just 'is'

indicators.note: return means the word for the setters is read backwards

parts.note: setters, referring to themselves collectively, are WE

explanation.surface: Setters coming back burst through a dog's doorway.
explanation.definitionFit: To entrance someone is to enchant or captivate them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: It would make Angus flip to take in recipe by first-class cook

indicators.note: to take in means the disease letters hold the next pieces inside them

parts.note: BSE, mad cow disease, would send an Angus cow mad
R abbreviates recipe (Latin recipe, 'take')
A1, written AI, means first-class

explanation.surface: Something that would infuriate a Scot named Angus gets a recipe from a top chef.
explanation.walkthrough: Angus is a Scottish breed of beef cattle, and 'flip' means go mad.
explanation.definitionFit: To braise is to cook slowly in liquid, a specific cooking method.

clue.text: Genius that scored in National having placed outside bet

indicators.note: having placed outside means the stake word is wrapped around the abbreviation

parts.note: a wager is a bet

explanation.surface: A punter places a bet on the Grand National.
explanation.walkthrough: The Grand National is Britain's famous steeplechase horse race; 'scored' means wrote music scores.
explanation.definitionFit: This composer was a musical genius who scored operas, i.e. wrote their music.

clue.text: Piece of gear to groom canines?

definitions.text: Piece of gear to groom canines?

parts.words: Piece of gear to groom canines?
parts.note: canines suggests dogs but means teeth; to groom them is to brush them

explanation.definitionFit: This is a toiletry item used to clean the canine teeth.

clue.text: Star with northern bird

parts.note: the star of a story is its hero

explanation.surface: A star sighting of a northern bird.
explanation.definitionFit: This long-legged wading bird is a species of bird, an example of the category.

clue.text: One fancies commercial on satellite station — theatrical drama?

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
Mir was the Soviet/Russian space station
ER is the TV hospital drama; the query nods to operating theatres

explanation.surface: Someone takes a fancy to an advert broadcast from a space station, as though a stage play.
explanation.definitionFit: An admirer is a person who fancies someone, a descriptive phrase for a suitor.

clue.text: Confirm when sure

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
certain means sure

explanation.definitionFit: To ascertain is to find out for certain, so it means to establish or confirm.

clue.text: 11's book: "Second one breaking open six-pack, perhaps how Sinatra did it, endlessly drunk consuming sauce"

parts.note: mo is a moment or second

indicators.note: breaking open means the numeral letter forces its way inside the muscles

parts.note: a six-pack is a set of well-defined abs
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: endlessly drops the last letter of the Sinatra phrase

parts.note: Sinatra sang that he did it My Way

indicators.note: consuming means the drinker swallows the condiment

parts.note: a sot is a drunkard
HP is a brand of brown sauce in Britain

explanation.surface: A rambling description of a lager six-pack, Sinatra and a drunk with a bottle of sauce.
explanation.walkthrough: Moab Is My Washpot is Stephen Fry's first memoir, titled from Psalm 60; HP Sauce is a familiar British brown sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: The 11-across entertainer wrote this autobiography, so it is literally his book.

clue.text: Unrealistic Abramovich starts to tear into Chelsea?

parts.note: Roman Abramovich was the owner of Chelsea football club

indicators.note: starts to picks the first letter of each following word

explanation.surface: A question whether the Chelsea owner is about to lay into his club.
explanation.definitionFit: Romantic can mean idealistic or impractical, a synonym for unrealistic.

clue.text: Change layout removing first "navy" from flag

indicators.note: removing first means the first occurrence of the letter is taken out

parts.note: the Red Ensign is the British merchant navy flag

explanation.surface: Redesigning a flag by removing the navy blue from it.
explanation.definitionFit: To redesign is to alter a layout or plan, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Blocking a good try with right difficulties

indicators.note: blocking means the last piece sits in the way, inside the run before it

parts.note: to have a go is to try

explanation.surface: A rugby match where a good try is blocked, leading to trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Aggro is British slang for trouble or aggravation, so difficulties fits as a loose synonym.

clue.text: Took back on medical ground

parts.note: re means on or concerning

indicators.note: ground means crushed and rearranged, so the letters of medical are reworked

explanation.surface: Someone recovered something on medical grounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Reclaimed means recovered or took possession again, a past-tense synonym.

clue.text: National treasure and good man — English writer capturing hearts with fine lines

parts.note: a saint, ST, is a good man

indicators.note: capturing means the writing tool holds the card-suit letter inside it

parts.note: a pen is something that writes
H is the card-game abbreviation for hearts
F stands for fine on pencils
RY abbreviates railway, a set of lines

explanation.surface: A beloved public figure is described as a decent English author with a gift for fine lines.
explanation.walkthrough: Stephen Fry is a British actor, writer and quiz host often called a national treasure.
explanation.definitionFit: A national treasure is a much-loved public figure, and this British entertainer is commonly labelled one.

clue.text: First to post off knickers for soldiers

indicators.note: off means the named letter is taken away from the underwear

parts.note: pants is British slang for knickers

indicators.note: first to picks the opening letter of post

explanation.surface: A risqué instruction to send underwear by post, addressed to troops.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers are a caste of certain insects, so the insect name stands for them by example.

clue.text: Plans redraft of catechisms

indicators.note: a redraft rewrites something, so the letters of catechisms are rearranged

explanation.surface: Plans to revise religious question-and-answer texts.
explanation.definitionFit: Schematics are diagrams or plans, a plural noun synonym.

clue.text: Studying 2's epic work without the use of Google, perhaps

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the epic surrounds the other piece

parts.note: 2-down's composer wrote the Ring cycle of operas
using Google is an e-search, an electronic search

explanation.surface: Someone researching the Ring cycle without going online.
explanation.definitionFit: Researching means investigating or studying a subject, a present-participle synonym.

clue.text: Incidental information in window by door

definitions.meaning: a piece of information shedding indirect light on a subject
a narrow window beside a door

explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both a side window and an incidental piece of information, two dictionary senses.

clue.text: About one Birmingham side with rules for residents

parts.note: C abbreviates circa, about
I is the Roman numeral one
Aston Villa is a Birmingham football club

explanation.surface: Something about a Birmingham football team and its rules for local people.
explanation.definitionFit: This body of law governs the rights of private citizens, i.e. residents.

clue.text: Business building bad press around record label

indicators.note: around means the jumbled letters go around the record label
bad signals that the letters of press are messed up

parts.note: EMI is a British record label

explanation.surface: A business attracting bad press over a record label.
explanation.definitionFit: Premises are the building and grounds a business occupies.

clue.text: See 20
Imagine Tramp would consume tablet

parts.note: Tramp is the setter, so 'Tramp would' is I'd
to eat is to consume
E is slang for an ecstasy tablet

explanation.surface: A tramp would swallow a pill.
explanation.definitionFit: To ideate is to form ideas, to imagine or conceive.

clue.text: A nerdier scientist rearranged drawer in house?

indicators.note: rearranged signals the letters of these three words are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A geeky scientist reorganised a drawer at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drawer' is not furniture but one who draws; an artist in residence works within an institution, the 'house'.
explanation.definitionFit: An artist attached to an institution draws (is a drawer) while living or working in that house.

clue.text: See 6
Crazy Baldrick idea, without the slightest bit of intelligence, repeatedly, on this?

definitions.text: Crazy Baldrick idea, without the slightest bit of intelligence, repeatedly, on this?

indicators.note: crazy signals the letters of the phrase are jumbled
without means the named letters are removed from the phrase
repeatedly means the single letter is taken out twice
the slightest bit picks just the first letter of intelligence

explanation.surface: Baldrick's latest mad scheme, lacking any intelligence at all, as ever.
explanation.walkthrough: Baldrick is the dim servant in the BBC sitcom Blackadder, famous for his 'cunning plans'; removing both I's from BALDRICKIDEA leaves BALDRCKDEA to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: The sitcom is where Baldrick's crazy unintelligent ideas appear, so the whole clue points to the show.

clue.text: Turning up to support shy creature

indicators.note: to support in a down clue means this piece sits below the other

parts.note: coy means shy

indicators.note: turning means the word up is read backwards

explanation.surface: A shy animal turns up to give support.
explanation.definitionFit: The coypu is a large South American rodent, an example of a creature.

clue.text: Power to rogue solicitor

parts.note: an imp is a rogue or rascal

explanation.surface: A powerful dodgy lawyer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pimp solicits clients for prostitutes, so one who solicits in that sense.

clue.text: Nostalgically upset, having lost coal production in a way that's permanent

indicators.note: upset signals the letters of the word are rearranged, after taking some away

explanation.surface: Feeling wistful about the mining industry that has disappeared.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having lost' and 'production' tell you to remove the letters of coal, in any order, from NOSTALGICALLY before rearranging.
explanation.definitionFit: Lastingly means in an enduring manner, an adverb matching the paraphrase.

clue.text: One from Middle East terrorist group joining 11 programme

parts.note: IRA is the Irish Republican Army
QI is the TV quiz once hosted by 11-across

explanation.surface: A Middle Eastern person linked with a militant group joins a TV show.
explanation.definitionFit: An Iraqi is a native of Iraq, a country in the Middle East.

clue.text: See 6
Like Elvis's shock — America cried around centre of Memphis

indicators.note: around means the US letters go round the middle letter

parts.note: US is America

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letter of Memphis

parts.note: wept means cried

explanation.surface: Fans in America wept around Memphis when Elvis died.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shock' here is a shock of hair: Elvis's quiff was swept up.
explanation.definitionFit: Hair brushed upward is upswept, describing the singer's famous quiff.
